implementation_summary: Added the BE<->FE A2UI contract test as a two-level check. Level 1 (always runs, works in backend CI where the frontend repo is absent): tests/codemie/core/test_a2ui_frontend_contract.py loads the vendored snapshot src/codemie/core/a2ui/frontend_manifest.json and asserts manifest['catalogId'] == catalog.CATALOG_ID and set(catalog.component_names()) <= set(manifest['components']) — the backend may never advertise to the LLM a component the renderer cannot draw. Level 2 (drift detection): if <repo>/../codemie-ui/src/a2ui/a2ui-manifest.json exists it asserts the vendored copy is byte-for-byte identical, failing with 'vendored frontend manifest is stale — copy codemie-ui/src/a2ui/a2ui-manifest.json over src/codemie/core/a2ui/frontend_manifest.json'; when the sibling checkout is missing the sub-test skips with an explicit reason. The manual-maintenance rule for the vendored copy is documented in the test module docstring (JSON cannot carry comments). Vendored file is an exact cp of codemie-ui@EPMCDME-13912 src/a2ui/a2ui-manifest.json (sha1 1a6ec6d23769b391ea70f9b876aace201ce8ff58; catalogId https://a2ui.org/specification/v0_9/catalogs/basic/catalog.json, protocolVersion v0.9.1, 18 components, compositionHash 1b35d06f). Both levels were verified to actually bite: temporarily removing 'Slider' and changing compositionHash in the vendored copy produced 2 failures (subset check + byte-identity), and restoring it returned to green. Cleanup: removed the unused pydantic field `catalog: Optional[dict] = None` from RequestUserInputTool and the `catalog` parameter of its __init__ — the attribute shadowed the imported `codemie.core.a2ui.catalog` module at class level and only worked because execute() resolves the module at runtime. grep over the repo confirmed no caller ever passed catalog= (only toolkit_service.py:602 and two tests construct the tool, all with thread_generator only).
